text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I are on our way back
to the
academy when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh? And who might you be?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
Girl in Pajamas
choice_data_list: (A child in pajamas? Alone out here?)

text_block_list.text: I-I really wanted to meet you, Opera O, but... but... Sniffle... sob...
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
Ah-ha, no need for tears. While they do
glisten
like beautiful pearls, a smile suits
you so much
better.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hmm... She appears to be lost.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: H-hic... O-Op... Um, Opera O... Sniffle!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
We'll need to calm her down first before
we can
help her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I am honored to meet you, Princess!
Should you
have no prior engagement...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Might I, the Overlord, be of service to
you as
your escort?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О holds out her hand, and
the girl
stops crying as she timidly takes
it. We should
take her to the police
station first.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Opera O agrees, but just as we turn to
go...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! I'm so sorry for the
trouble!
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text:
Oh... You are a nurse, I take it? Do you
know this
little one?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Y-yes... She's a patient at the—wait...
Aren't you
Т.М. Опера О?!
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text:
Oh? I see you know me. Well, of course
you
would have knowledge of my name!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That girl is a fan of yours... and it seems
she snuck
off after finding out Tracen
Academy was nearby.
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text:
You can't do that, understand? We were
all so
worried about you.
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text: I... I-I... um... S-sorry... Hic!
text_block_list.name: Girl in Pajamas

text_block_list.text:
I ask that you please excuse her just this
once! My
captivating beauty is to blame.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: As an apology, I offer you a collectible photograph of myself—no! Ten copies of my film, 24 Hours with You: An Opera Anthology for you and every person at the hospital as well!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... That's very nice of you, but,
well...
Anyways, thank you for looking
after her!
text_block_list.name: Nurse

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Sneaking out of a hospital all just to meet me.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How corruptible it is, this beauty of
mine!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Yes, from the joy of meeting me, and
from
reflecting on the hardship of her
solitary journey.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Cars and signage abound in this place.
Many a
thing must appear a giant
monstrosity to a child
of her age.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But she overcame her fears all for the
sake of
seeing me with her own eyes.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Relief, joy, and a sense of
accomplishment surely
enveloped her
upon arrival... That is to say, those
tears
were proof of her courage.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ahh! Such an admirable soul! I must
open my
heart to such purity!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O comprehends the entire well of
emotion
behind the girl's tears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However! Sneaking away from a hospital
is an act
far too dangerous!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I must offer a gift that will both ease her
heart
and curb those impulses.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: How about you inspire her with your efforts?

text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, that would be best.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We must begin training right away,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I will create a short, two-hour piece
which can be
performed within visitation
hours. With me in the
starring role, it
shall be an excellent opera!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: An excellent idea!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Then what are we waiting for? There are

preparations to be made, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
For the photographs, of course! Her
album of me
will not fill itself!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Me during twilight, me under starlight...
Ah yes,
and me at dawn!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And so, Т.М. Опера О adamantly insists
that I
help with taking her photos.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I manage to convince her that, instead of
an
opera, her brilliance on the racetrack
would be a
better gift.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
